name: unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T
rule: If any other Arc or Weak pointers to the same allocation as this exist, their inner type must be exactly the same as this Arc's inner type, including lifetimes.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::sync::Arc < T , A > { unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T }
expression: No valid DSL expression exists for this requirement: the grammar cannot quantify over other Arc or Weak pointers or compare their inner types and lifetimes.
